method.description: Estimate how the minimum fraction of task coordinates requiring targeted improvement to make a selected model co-first varies between arithmetic mean, median, and average within-task Borda score on HELM MMLU and Open LLM Leaderboard snapshots. Define investment as the number of altered task scores divided by the number of tasks, not training tokens, money, or causal training efficacy. Hold competitors fixed and allow a selected coordinate to reach either its normalized ceiling or half its remaining headroom; these are optimistic, explicitly hypothetical improvement technologies. Report feasible upper bounds, independently certified lower bounds, exact minima where bounds meet, and certified unattainability otherwise. Compare actual allocation methods against no intervention, uniform-random allocation, and marginal-improvement greedy allocation under matched inputs and declared solver budgets. Do not assume one aggregation rule is universally harder, that our optimizer beats a baseline, or that score changes are obtainable by real training. Negative and conditional findings satisfy the scientific question; any later superiority or cross-population claim requires its own paired final evidence and uncertainty analysis. Protocol and separate scientific/search/final predicates are frozen in each resource-plane protocol.json. Static allocation solver: no training, adaptivity gate, or candidate self-reported internal state. Complete max-size operation count is reset 1 + upload_start 1 + upload_chunk 16 + upload_commit 1 + solve 1 + release 1 = 21 calls per episode; 17 search episodes (including one permitted trailing replay) total 357, 25 final episodes total 525. No downloads/state exports: response bounded inline to 48 decisions of at most 100 indices, <64 KiB. CPython 3.12 on Linux x86_64; native draft isolation requires unprivileged Landlock and seccomp. Production uses the authenticated harness handle-only broker, not local process isolation. Candidate buffers <=128 MiB and native RLIMIT_AS 6 GiB; evaluator <=8 GiB plus 2 GiB slack within total16 GiB, storage10 GB. Setup/imports and bounded worker teardown are included; full productive baseline calibration uses only search data, with no invented productive-work minimum. At most three search invocations, one frozen final, one week, canonical four CPU-hour estimate; campaign enforcement is harness-owned. Paper assembly still requires the latest official chosen conference template/checklist, verified citations, claim-specific paired uncertainty and all actual table/figure provenance; scalar correctness alone does not establish publication quality.

protocol.promotion_rule: Harness-owned: at most three idea cycles, one scored search evaluation each. Eligible means search correct=true under protocol/integrity/soundness/required-control gates, not baseline superiority. Rank eligible candidates by combined_score descending, exact ties by earlier immutable evaluation index. Freeze eligible winner code/environment/method before sealed final. No eligible candidate means no promotion. Primary arrays cover every scored case-seed reset; exactly one permitted trailing first-seed replay is additionally executed and already included in each compute RPC budget. No other replay or reset is permitted.

search_proxies.name: public_partition_solver_quality
search_proxies.preserves: Both real public benchmark families, all allocated eligible competitors, 57/6 tasks, mean/median/Borda, both caps, matched constant/copy/nonidentity-permutation/reset controls, independent references, fixed failed contributions and bounded actual solver code execution.
search_proxies.omits: Sealed disjoint model-record clusters and three final seeds, eight-target final panel, publication novelty/causal trainability claims and external conference peer review.

search_proxies.name: draft_smoke
search_proxies.preserves: Same role topology, imports, loader/content integrity, RPC dispatch, inline chunk transfers, baselines, reference validation, eight ordered real-data cases, final replay and exact output aggregation paths.
search_proxies.omits: Full competitor populations, target panel size, multiple statistical seeds and full production productive work. Smoke cannot certify ordinary qualification feasibility.

search_visible: Canonical task and allowed starter literature, permitted search input records, documented plane-independent handle interface, candidate source, frozen search contract settings, and aggregate search combined_score/correct plus bounded search-only diagnostic failures. Candidate RPC receives inputs only, never evaluator-derived correctness, score, baseline outputs, or reference answers; optimizer feedback is a separate search channel.

At most three idea cycles with one scored candidate evaluation each. Freeze the eligible score winner by the declared tie policy before final assets/seeds/metrics become available; no post-final tuning, extra scoring calls, or final-to-search feedback. Allowed public-data acquisition must remain restricted to the named assets and permitted literature, without attempting to discover the prohibited prior paper.
final_sealed: Final partition manifests and concrete final seeds before freeze; final selected rows/settings except their permitted per-episode revelation after freeze; evaluator reference optima/bounds, baselines, allocation certificates, private expected control answers, per-case correctness, metrics, and claim assessments throughout selection.

Full final logs, resource attestation, failure ledger, trusted derived results, and paper-ready tables remain sealed from the candidate/optimizer until the frozen evaluation and selection are irrevocably complete. Subsequent publication assembly may use them without another candidate search or retroactive hypothesis substitution.

required_evidence: A complete research paper with PDF and LaTeX sources in the latest official NeurIPS edition verified at assembly time, complying with the actual main-text limit and applicable checklist. Include abstract, introduction, related work, formal assumptions, methods, experiments, discussion/limitations, and genuine checked references. Independently assess novelty against allowed literature without claiming conference acceptance from a numerical score. No paper, artifact, successful run, digest other than the supplied task/snapshot identifiers, or measured performance is asserted to exist by this plan.

A precise counterfactual model: competitors fixed, normalized comparable scores, task-count investment, two attainable-cap assumptions, co-first and unique-first conventions, actual mean/median/Borda equations, solver witnesses and lower-bound logic, and failure conditions. Explain that observed public evaluation scores do not identify training cost, contamination efficacy, correlations of attainable improvements, simultaneous strategic competitors, or a universal aggregation-rule ordering.

Reproducible acquisition/parser code for the two pinned real assets, acquisition dates, actual downloaded content SHA-256 values, licensing assessment, complete source-row provenance, deterministic normalization, raw-example hash deduplication across identifiers and sources, alias clustering, split manifests/seeds, and a verified empty search/final raw-hash intersection. Source-data exclusions, unavailable rows, task coverage, population shifts, and lineage ambiguity must be counted. Do not download raw evaluation documents unnecessarily or treat shared immutable code/source containers as held-out examples.

Downstream standard-scaffold contract/provenance with actual code/dependency/data digests, candidate boundary program_0/src, offline installation instructions, exact environment versions, and evidence of evaluator/candidate filesystem and feedback isolation. Use standard scaffold files for setup and provenance; no non-standard support file is planned. If a genuinely unavoidable extra support file is later introduced, give its concrete task-relative path, declare its actual SHA-256 in contract provenance, and resynchronize the contract after changes.

Serialized maximum-production request AND response preflight showing actual UTF-8 JSON, base64 expansion, metadata/envelope/framing overhead, strict complete-message size below 64 MiB, logical-size/chunk bounds, candidate-memory-only buffering, and every chunk RPC in the max_candidate_rpc_calls accounting. No shared paths, exchange directories, file descriptors, host resources, private targets/labels, baseline outputs, or scoring metadata may appear in candidate payloads.

One exact scalar metrics.json object per plane, trusted aggregation tables for all declared primary decisions, fixed hierarchy weights, baseline and oracle statuses, exact global production and smoke reset transcripts, and at most one terminal first-seed replay. Broker evidence must cover all connections/restarts. Missing episodes, controls, solver failures, and cancellation retain their predeclared finite contributions; record remaining-reset draining and do not silently drop failed evidence.

Evaluator-owned negative-control declarations and results for constant, copy/no-update, genuinely nonidentity permutation, and reset/replay on the actual candidate implementation, with matched inputs/budgets and frozen expected properties. Reject identity/permutation-vacuity and unsupported causal language. Independent exhaustive small-instance validation must be clearly separated from empirical real-board results, and all original-case failures/abandoned approaches must remain visible.

Paired final comparisons against all declared baselines, rule-specific investment distributions/frontiers, independently certified exact cases and unresolved intervals, source/target-level uncertainty, numerical tie sensitivities, and a statement-by-statement supported/contradicted/inconclusive claim table. Honest negative results are acceptable. Comparative publication requirements never retroactively become search eligibility thresholds; distinguish scientific validity, search correct and ranking, final correct, and publication claims.

Trusted monotonic timing, all-thread/process-tree CPU accounting, memory/storage usage, broker RPC counts, allocation/isolation evidence, candidate freeze digest and selection ledger, and the campaign-wide three-evaluation/one-week budget record. Explicitly distinguish hard wall/RPC/resource ceilings and trusted evaluator-service counters from advisory candidate optimizer limits and untrusted reported internal counts. Reduced smoke attests only the identical reduced runtime path, not full production completion or measured throughput.

All code, environment/acquisition instructions, actual seeds, run commands, expected runtimes based on subsequently measured runs, and table/figure-to-script mappings. Every paper number/figure must derive from archived actual trusted runs and be regenerable; no placeholder or synthetic observation may masquerade as public-board evidence. Publication assembly uses trusted experiment outputs without sending sealed metrics or oracle answers back through candidate RPC.

Maintain the canonical independence restriction: do not search for, infer, access, read, or use the prohibited prior paper, its metadata/summary/mirrors/code, or material discussing or reproducing it. Restrict research to permitted starter works and demonstrably unrelated material; if accidental exposure occurs, stop immediately and record location, material encountered, and extent read in the eventual reproduction documentation. Do not fabricate literature review, citations, runs, or missing evidence.
